Name: Unscary kids
Author: transgendirk
Description:
[center][b]Do you avoid talking to the kids of Stardew because they look weird? Maybe like they're grown adults just dressing up as children? Me too.[/b]
[font=Times New Roman]This portrait mod redesigns Leo, Vincent and Jas to look adorable and more like children, without sacrificing the original games portrait style.[/font]

[font=Times New Roman][i]Like other portrait mods, this requires SMAPI and Content Patcher [CP] to load.[/i][/font]

[u][b]Guide[/b][/u]

1. Download the folder and [u]extract it[/u]. Put the extracted folder into the "Mods" folder in the stardew valley game folder.
2. Make sure You also have SMAPI and Content Patcher downloaded correctly.
3. You're done! SMAPI and Content patcher should recognize the mod and run it.[/center]

Downloads.Description: - Adjusted jas' shading on her bang to fit the contour of the hair more accurately

Manifest.Description: Make the kids look less creepy.
